candidates.change_summary: Change the per-call require(_s) to only revert when the call fails and v is nonzero, allowing failures when v==0 and thereby potentially returning true even if some calls fail.
Invert the call success check so the function returns true only if every call fails (require success is replaced by require(!_s)).
Remove the require(_s) so call failures no longer revert and the function can return true even if some calls fail.
Change the function to return false immediately if any inner call succeeds, flipping the meaning of success.
